title: 600Breezy - Breezo George Gervin: Leading Scorer Edition
htmlContent: Forever an inventive slick-talker, Chicago's 600Breezy's distinct blend of drill rap emphasizes raw, violent lyricism. Returning with his first full-length project since 2016, Breezy delivers Breezo George Gervin (Leading Scorer Edition), a collection of South Side stories.  Packed with gritty drill instrumentals and creative threats, blows, and flexes from breeze and his guest stars Al-Doe, Bishop Ford, Parkay, mackerel, and Chicago legend Young Chop, Breezo George Gervin (Leading Scorer Edition) is a thrilling and claustrophobic listen.  Our guide through his treacherous streets, 600Breezy has been boundlessly charismatic, forever finding new ways to explain exactly how and why he is better, harder, and more productive than you.  Distributed by EMPIRE and powered by Rita Lee of Nuface Entertainment, Breezo George Gervin (Leading Scorer Edition) demonstrates why some of the greatest names in hip-hop are betting on his success.     https://soundcloud.com/600breezo/sets/breezo-george-gervin-leading
